summary: Completed comprehensive testing of EduNiti AI Tutor application. Backend testing achieved 92.9% success rate (13/14 tests passed). All new features working correctly: chat actions (simplify/elaborate/quiz), grade-specific subjects, enhanced quiz submission with response times, and conversation history. Frontend registration and basic navigation working, but session management issues prevent complete end-to-end testing.
